title: Maximum Subarray Sum
statement: Find the maximum sum among all nonempty contiguous subarrays. Negative values are allowed, so the answer may be negative when every element is negative. The array is nonempty. Read the input format below and print only the numeric answer, with no label or explanation.
input_format: First line n; second line n integers.
output_format: One integer: the maximum subarray sum.
reference_python:
import sys
a=list(map(int,sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))[1:];s=best=a[0]
for x in a[1:]:s=max(x,s+x);best=max(best,s)
print(best)
intended_complexity: O(n) time, O(1) extra space using Kadane's algorithm
